# Display the first few rows of the dataset
df.head()

# Check for missing values and data types
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()
data_types = df.dtypes

missing_info = pd.DataFrame({'Missing Values': missing_values, 'Data Type': data_types})

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Initialize the label encoder
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()

# Impute missing values only for numeric columns
numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['float64']).columns
df[numeric_cols] = df[numeric_cols].fillna(df[numeric_cols].mean())

# Encode the target variable
df['patient_outcome'] = label_encoder.fit_transform(df['patient_outcome'])

# Display the updated dataset information
df.info()

from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

# Separate features and target variable
X = df.drop(columns=['patient_outcome'])
y = df['patient_outcome']

# Calculate mutual information
mutual_info = mutual_info_classif(X, y, random_state=42)

# Create a DataFrame to hold the mutual information values
mutual_info_df = pd.DataFrame(mutual_info, index=X.columns, columns=['Mutual Information'])

# Sort the DataFrame by mutual information values
top_features = mutual_info_df.sort_values(by='Mutual Information', ascending=False).head(5)
top_features

from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.metrics import make_scorer, accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score

# Select the top features for training
X_top = X[top_features.index]

# Initialize the SVM classifier
svm_classifier = SVC(random_state=42)

# Perform cross-validation
accuracy_scores = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top, y, cv=5, scoring='accuracy')
precision_scores = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top, y, cv=5, scoring=make_scorer(precision_score))
recall_scores = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top, y, cv=5, scoring=make_scorer(recall_score))

# Calculate mean scores
mean_accuracy = accuracy_scores.mean()
mean_precision = precision_scores.mean()
mean_recall = recall_scores.mean()

mean_accuracy, mean_precision, mean_recall

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Initialize PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)

# Fit and transform the data
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_top)

# Create a DataFrame for the PCA results
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(data=X_pca, columns=['PCA1', 'PCA2'])
pca_df['patient_outcome'] = y

# Plot the PCA results
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(pca_df[pca_df['patient_outcome'] == 0]['PCA1'], 
            pca_df[pca_df['patient_outcome'] == 0]['PCA2'], 
            label='Benign', alpha=0.5)
plt.scatter(pca_df[pca_df['patient_outcome'] == 1]['PCA1'], 
            pca_df[pca_df['patient_outcome'] == 1]['PCA2'], 
            label='Malignant', alpha=0.5)
plt.title('PCA of Patient Readmission Data')
plt.xlabel('PCA Component 1')
plt.ylabel('PCA Component 2')
plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()
